evidence_quote: We conducted longitudinal genomic surveillance of 282 carbapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae (CRKP) isolates (225 sputum, 57 blood) between 2021and 2024 to characterize population structure, source-associated genomic adaptations, and plasmid evolution.
rationale: The study examines bacterial resistance, virulence, and genomic adaptation in respiratory and bloodstream infections. It does not address tumor progression, cancer biomarkers, or experimental or clinical cancer treatments.
